topic_title: Legal Definition of Intoxication in Texas
prompt: What is the legal BAC limit for commercial motor vehicle drivers operating in Texas?

options.text: 0.04 BAC is the legal commercial threshold, half the standard adult driver limit
0.08 BAC, which applies identically to commercial and passenger drivers alike
0.00 BAC, meaning zero alcohol metabolites can ever be detected in body
0.06 BAC when operating tractor-trailers during nighttime delivery hours
